title: The Trerrote Connection
subtitle: Omaggio a Tony Tammaro

authors.role: game design, programming, pixel art, music, documentation
authors.name: Claude Code (Anthropic)

acknowledgements: This is a tribute game for the myth of many generations: il Grande Maestro Tony Tammaro (https://www.tonytammaro.com).
It is unofficial: made by fans, not made, endorsed or reviewed by Tony Tammaro. Its use of his name, and of Patrizia and the Trerrote, is homage.
It contains none of his music, lyrics, recordings or images. The soundtrack is original, written for this game in the general style of Neapolitan cassette pop.
Every picture is painted from text sources in tools/, after the real places. No photograph is traced or sampled.
Every sound is the PRG32 SID-like synthesizer playing an original score. No samples, no recordings.
Tools and the sequencer are adapted from You Have Got Pizza: Deluxe Edition and Drumfight Napoli 97 (PRG32 family, MIT).
content_notice: Comic road mayhem. Nobody is ever run over: pedestrians jump clear, and they keep the melon.
